name: Sick Children
overview: Scripture recognizes the preciousness of children as a heritage from the LORD and assures His care and strengthening during times of sickness, as seen in Psalms 127:3 and Psalms 41:3. Believers are encouraged to trust in God’s goodness and strength amid trials, including the suffering of children, knowing that such tribulations develop patience (Nahum 1:7; Romans 5:3). Jesus also emphasizes the value of children, reminding us that their angels are in the presence of the Father, underscoring God’s attentive care for the little ones (Matthew 18:10). Those who wait on the LORD will find renewed strength to endure, reflecting the hope and comfort available to families facing the challenges of sick children (Isaiah 40:31).
